name: @equin/plugin-packages-socket-buffer
description: A connected socket's kernel send buffer, read and raised through bun:ffi on macOS and Linux: socketBufferSizes(socket) reads SO_SNDBUF / SO_RCVBUF, raiseSocketSendBuffer(socket, bytes) raises SO_SNDBUF to at least bytes and never lowers it. On a macOS Unix stream socket the sender's SO_SNDBUF (8 KB by default) bounds what is in flight, so a large write leaves one buffer per event-loop turn.
